text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, thank you for having me!
I'm Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the outfit for tomorrow's traffic safety class...
...Yes, that's right.
You previously mentioned plain clothes would be fine, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
On that day, we'd like to visit wearing
our coolest outfits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Traffic Safety"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: Likewise! I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the 'Children's Traffic Safety Class,' where Fenomeno will be making a guest appearance.
choice_data_list: Are the children inside the venue?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes. I really want to show them Fenomeno-san's admirable conduct.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: Um, they've been getting awfully mischievous lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler A
text_block_list.text: It's a yellow light! Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schoolers
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: STOOOOOP!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*...
Boss, did we manage to round up all the runners...?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everyone is here...! 
So please continue...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fifteen minutes into the 'Traffic Safety Class.'
Phenomeno and the adults were struggling...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone?!
I thought this officer was just talking
about 'traffic lights'?!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schoolers
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...
I shall forgive...
I will forgive, and listen...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh, these words...!
Even though I'm being forgiven, it feels like I'm somehow being forced to bow my head... What a bizarre feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I won't give up!
Next question! A friend is trying to cross where there's no crosswalk!
What do you do!?"

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler C
text_block_list.text:
"A kid crossing where there's no crosswalk...
Umm, I should scold them and say 'You can't do that!'..."

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schoolers
text_block_list.text:
Make it a chair...? 
Slam it down...? 
Kick it awayyy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's quite dangerous, sir/ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schoolers
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhhh?!
No wayyy?! But whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler B
text_block_list.text: Because that's what Orfe would do!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh, is this Orfe-san's influence...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Orfevre achieved the ultimate dream
of any Umamusume, reigning supreme as a
"Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through the media, the children saw it too: the dazzling brilliance of a king who conquered the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler A
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe was seriously so cool!
Blowing past everyone in that race!"

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
Acting all high and mighty, doing whatever she wants, yet so cool!
I wanna be just like Orfe too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh............ It's true!
Orfevre-san is an Umamusume who achieved remarkable success!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, if you're looking for a role model
for your everyday personal life—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: How about an Umamusume like this?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah——!!
choice_data_list: ――! If the children see her run――

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler A
text_block_list.text: Ah, look, pill bugs!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
It's true!
Present it to me as tribute--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes
our 'Traffic Safety Class.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tear up thinking about how Fenomeno must feel.
She came here today to be a role model for the children, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schoolers
text_block_list.text:
"Good job...
Here is your reward...
A pill bug..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I humbly accept...!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...
I am so terribly sorry.
Fenomeno-san, Traine—"

Wait, wait, waaaait!
You guys seriously fine with this?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The resonant blow of a conch shell echoed.
Looking back, who was standing there but—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: It's Golshi~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here comes today's guest!
choice_data_list: Huh... She was a guest too!?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
N-No, wait?! The only one
we invited was Fenomeno...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Don't go having fun without meeeeee!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mbobo!! Mbobob-bobo!
Mbobonbo!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mame-chin! Out!
You didn't say the line, so
you're the next Nbobo "it", Mame-chin!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You guys run away quickly too!
The Npopo Yokai is gonna show up next!!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha!! No way!
What was thaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Elementary Schooler D
text_block_list.text: Kufufu... Npopo--!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gaaah, Npopo's already here! Golshi-chan's gonna take you down!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hop on my back!
It's time for an exorcism ritual!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So jealous!
Golshi, I want an Npopo too-!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Npopo-! Npopo-! Npopo-!
Npopo-! Npopo-! Npopo-!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! Gold Ship is a genius at sniffing out fun things
and bringing even more chaos to the situation...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. We have severely underestimated the influence of Orfevre-san and Golshi-san.
At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What comes to the world is the end of the century!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The year 20XX.
The children of the surface world
had fallen into the path of evil...

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: Stop...! That's the very last shoji screen...!

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Boy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, like I care!
Ora ora ora oraaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo!
The shoji screens are full of hoooles--!?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uhehehe...!
I went and forgot my umbrella at home again...

text_block_list.name: Easily-Influenced Girl
text_block_list.text:
Let's just buy some at the convenience store, then~♪
Mommy, can I have another one, pleeease?♡

text_block_list.name: Children's Parents
text_block_list.text:
Give me a breeeaaak!
The umbrella stand is already completely fuuull!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha—don't get swept away!!
Everyone, do nooot go over to that side!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Stop copying Golshi-san!
And stop copying Orfe-san too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What you need is a pure, righteous admiration!
You must not be swept away by dangerous, potent temptations! If you are—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What awaits in the future is the end of the century...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Gh, I'm sorry, Boss...!
I blew it...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I failed to win back the children's hearts until the very end...!
It is entirely due to my own immaturity...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had the power to tickle kids' hearts
like Orfe-san, Golshi-san, or a pill bug...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Setting pill bugs aside, it seems Orfevre and
Gold Ship rank high among the Umamusume that
kids these days want to imitate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then, to shift this balance of power,
what Fenomeno and I can do is—"
choice_data_list: Then let's make this year your biggest success yet!
Then let's make this year your biggest success yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just like Orfevre won the Triple Crown and became famous among the kids, if Fenomeno keeps winning too—!
choice_data_list: I know you'll definitely become someone others admire!
I'm sure you can become someone everyone looks up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh, that's right!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We must not give up!
This incident can be resolved easily!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —If only I could stand out more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (If only I could become someone who catches everyone's eye...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Just like Orfe-san and Golshi-san.
A run that children would watch with pure delight...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san.
May I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, Eishin Flash...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Eishin Flash... Polite and punctual, she's a classmate of mine who debuted two generations prior.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided which events you'll participate in for the Fan Appreciation Festival?
The submission deadline is the day after tomorrow, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. That's true.
It's already that time of year—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—A Thanksgiving Festival...!
That's it...!!”
